CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
POWER STANDARD RATE - RENEWABLE ACCESS SERVICE
This rate is for individually metered Power Class customers served through customer
owned transformation and self-generating a portion of their electricity needs using
renewable sources as a participant under SaskPower's Renewable Access Service.
Self-Generation Sources - Renewable self-generation sources include solar, wind, flare
gas, biomass, geothermal and hydropower generation. All other sources are considered
non-renewable. Rate Codes* R23 R24
Effective February 1, 2026
Supply voltage 72kV 100kV & above
Basic monthly charge $8,151.50 $8,731.50
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand each $18.088 $17.821
month
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 5.508¢ 4.695¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge.
RECORDED DEMAND
The monthly recorded demand is the maximum kVA demand registered during the
current month.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
BILLING DEMAND
The monthly billing demand is the monthly recorded demand, but the billing demand shall not be less than 75 per cent of the maximum billing demand in the preceding 11
months.
